annotations.title: Contractor vs employee true annual cost calculator

description: Compare the full annual cost of a W-2 employee, including payroll taxes and overhead, with the cost of a 1099 contractor for the same work. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

benefits.description: Benefits per year (health, retirement match, paid leave premiums) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for benefits per year (health, retirement match, paid leave premiums). Unknown is not the same as zero.

contractor.description: Contractor fees for the year (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for contractor fees for the year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

equipment.description: Equipment, software and supplies per year (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for equipment, software and supplies per year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

extras.description: Contractor extras per year (onboarding, 1099 filing, tools you supply) (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for contractor extras per year (onboarding, 1099 filing, tools you supply). Unknown is not the same as zero.

futaBase.description: FUTA wage base (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for futa wage base. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 7000 USD from IRS Topic no. 759, Form 940 FUTA tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

futaNet.description: Net FUTA rate after full state credit. Enter as a percent number. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for net futa rate after full state credit. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 0.6% from IRS Topic no. 759, Form 940 FUTA tax, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

med.description: Employer Medicare rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for employer medicare rate. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 1.45% from SSA contribution and benefit base, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

payroll.description: Payroll service and admin per year (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for payroll service and admin per year. Unknown is not the same as zero.

ss.description: Employer Social Security rate. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for employer social security rate. Unknown is not the same as zero. Official reference value 6.2% from SSA contribution and benefit base, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

ssBase.description: Social Security wage base (US dollars). SSA lists $184,500 for 2026 and $192,300 for 2027. Official reference value 184500 USD from SSA contribution and benefit base, effective 2026-01-01. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

suta.description: State unemployment (SUTA) rate (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Use the rate on your state unemployment tax rate notice.

sutaBase.description: State unemployment taxable wage base (your figure) (US dollars). Your state publishes its taxable wage base each year.

wage.description: Employee annual wages (US dollars). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for employee annual wages. Unknown is not the same as zero.

wc.description: Workers comp rate per $100 of payroll (your figure) (US dollars). From your policy or quote for this job’s class code.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.
